vmc.expression.description: Makes your 3D avatar show an expression, like a smile, using VMC. Works with VSeeFace, VMagicMirror, VNyan, Warudo and other apps with a VMC receiver.

fields.expression: The expression's name on your avatar. Every VRM avatar has Joy, Angry, Sorrow, Fun and Surprised; yours may have more.
fields.strength: How strong, from 0 (none) to 1 (full), or a percentage like 50%. Empty means full.
fields.seconds: How long to show it before it goes away. Empty means it stays until another step changes it.

vmc.clearExpressions.description: Takes expressions off your 3D avatar again (sets them back to 0).

fields.expressions: The expression names to take off, separated by commas.
